cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've put your usual mug out. We can still have tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still? Are you cross with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'm hoping you won't leave me cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

mechanism: A treats reconciliation as a technical task and patiently corrects defective apologies until B acknowledges personal responsibility, never stating the offense.
confusable: Generic resentment lacks correction of the form and agency of an apology as though A is the sole qualified practitioner.
comparison: Parents-visit alternative works under a public deadline with message symbols rather than a private tea reconciliation.
seedUse: Tea seed supplies a nonapology and kept-warm offer; S03 can act through precise wording corrections without naming what happened.
